description: Got one verse, and refused a second.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Named tenpence a head, reported a winter without a purse-quarrel, and touched the table.
name: John Heminges

description: Made Nashe pay for one cup, and told you to go before you lent him anything.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Came uninvited, spent the room on Harvey, sang one verse, and paid a penny.
name: Thomas Nashe

description: Asked to fast from explanations, and stayed with the marrow.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Ate through the argument, and kept the fast outside the parlour.
name: Will Kemp

description: Spoke the two sums, refused the loan, and stopped.
name: William Shakespeare
